resources.string: Restores AOSP digital assistant behavior on China-region ColorOS builds: holding the power button, holding the navigation bar, and swiping in from the bottom corners all wake the system default assistant.
When disabled, all three triggers revert to original ColorOS behavior

Each of the three triggers keeps its own target. With no target selected, this trigger wakes no assistant (ColorOS\'s native invocation is also suppressed).
Changes to the bottom corner swipe take effect after a reboot. Until then the launcher may keep showing the gesture animation.
